SEATTLE — U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Storis (WAGB 21) returned to its temporary home port of Seattle on Saturday after completing a 133‑day deployment to the Arctic Ocean and Alaska theater of operations. 
  
During the deployment, Storis traveled more than 17,000 nautical miles while serving as the sole U.S. surface asset in the High Arctic, conducting maritime safety, security, border control and sovereignty missions.

carriers.title: George Washington Dental Team Boosts Readiness in U.S. 5th Fleet
carriers.description: ARABIAN SEA (Nov. 13, 2026) — A dental tiger team from the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) embarked on six destroyers during its deployment, providing dental care to more than 600 Sailors – most recently the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Shoup (DDG 86), to provide annual dental exams to the crew, supporting operational readiness while ships operate in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations.

carriers.title: Deployed Resiliency Counseling While at Sea
carriers.description: U.S. Navy deployments routinely test Sailors with physical and mental demands that come with shipboard life. Sailors have many resources available to them to include the Deployment Resiliency Counselor (DRC), to help them cope with underway challenges and stress.
